dashboard.label: Infrastructure Health
dashboard.description: Deep-dive on the health of the Splunk deployment itself: indexing pipeline queues, indexing volume, host resource usage, errors/warnings, the search scheduler, disk usage per index, forwarder connections, KV store and cluster status. Fleet-wide panels use `splunk_server=*` and only see instances configured as distributed search peers of wherever this app is installed - see the README for the multi-site prerequisite. All searches run directly against index=_internal, index=_introspection-free internal metrics.log events, and Splunk's own REST endpoints - no add-on required.

search.query: | rest /services/search/distributed/peers splunk_server=local | table peerName, site, status, version, build, replicationStatus | sort site, peerName | rename peerName as "Peer", site as Site, status as Status, version as Version, build as Build, replicationStatus as "Replication Status"

| rest /services/server/info splunk_server=* | eval uptime_days=round(uptime/86400,1), mem_gb=round(physicalMemoryMB/1024,1) | table splunk_server, serverName, version, os_name, uptime_days, numberOfCores, mem_gb | sort splunk_server | rename splunk_server as "Splunk Server", serverName as "Server Name", version as Version, os_name as OS, uptime_days as "Uptime (days)", numberOfCores as "CPU Cores", mem_gb as "Memory (GB)"
| rest /services/server/info splunk_server=local | table version
| rest /services/server/info splunk_server=local | eval uptime_days=round(uptime/86400,1) | table uptime_days
| rest /services/server/info splunk_server=local | table numberOfCores
| rest /services/server/info splunk_server=local | eval mem_gb=round(physicalMemoryMB/1024,1) | table mem_gb
`audit_queue_fill` | timechart span=2m avg(pct_full) by name limit=0
`audit_queue_fill` | stats latest(pct_full) as PctFull by host, name | sort -PctFull | rename host as Host, name as Queue, PctFull as "% Full"

panel.title: Fleet-Wide Avg CPU / Memory - Last 4 Hours

search.query: `audit_hostwide_metrics` | timechart span=5m avg(cpu_system_pct) as "CPU System %" avg(cpu_user_pct) as "CPU User %" avg(pct_memory) as "Memory %"

`audit_hostwide_metrics` | stats latest(cpu_system_pct) as CPUSystem, latest(cpu_user_pct) as CPUUser, latest(pct_memory) as Memory by host | eval CPUSystem=round(CPUSystem,1), CPUUser=round(CPUUser,1), Memory=round(Memory,1) | sort -Memory | rename host as Host, CPUSystem as "CPU System %", CPUUser as "CPU User %", Memory as "Memory %"
`audit_per_index_thruput` earliest=-24h | eval GB=kb/1024/1024 | stats sum(GB) as GB by series | sort -GB | head 10 | rename series as Index

panel.title: Errors & Warnings by Host & Component - Last 24h

search.query: `audit_errors_warnings` earliest=-24h | stats count by host, component, log_level | sort -count | head 20 | rename host as Host
`audit_errors_warnings` earliest=-24h | timechart span=1h count by log_level

`audit_scheduler_log` status=skipped earliest=-24h | stats count by savedsearch_name, app, user | sort -count | head 15 | rename savedsearch_name as "Saved Search", app as App, user as User, count as "Skips (24h)"

`audit_forwarder_connections` earliest=-1h | eval forwarder=coalesce(hostname,sourceHost,sourceIp) | stats latest(_time) as LastSeen sum(kb) as KB by host, forwarder, connectionType | eval LastSeen=strftime(LastSeen,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"), KB=round(KB,1) | sort -KB | rename host as "Receiving Indexer", forwarder as Forwarder, connectionType as Type, KB as "KB Transferred", LastSeen as "Last Seen"

| rest /services/data/indexes splunk_server=* | eval SizeGB=round(currentDBSizeMB/1024,2), MaxGB=round(maxTotalDataSizeMB/1024,2), PctUsed=if(maxTotalDataSizeMB>0,round((currentDBSizeMB/maxTotalDataSizeMB)*100,1),0) | table splunk_server, title, SizeGB, MaxGB, PctUsed, totalEventCount | sort -PctUsed | rename splunk_server as "Splunk Server", title as Index, SizeGB as "Size (GB)", MaxGB as "Max Size (GB)", PctUsed as "% of Max", totalEventCount as "Events"

panel.title: Disk Space by Partition (vs. minFreeSpace threshold)

search.query: | rest /services/server/status/partitions-space splunk_server=* | eval FreeGB=round(free/1024,2), CapacityGB=round(capacity/1024,2), PctFree=if(capacity>0,round((free/capacity)*100,1),0) | join type=left splunk_server [ | rest /services/server/settings splunk_server=* | eval MinFreeGB=round(minFreeSpace/1024,2) | fields splunk_server MinFreeGB ] | eval Status=case(FreeGB<MinFreeGB,"CRITICAL",FreeGB<(MinFreeGB*2),"WARNING",true(),"OK") | table splunk_server, title, FreeGB, CapacityGB, PctFree, MinFreeGB, Status | sort splunk_server, PctFree | rename splunk_server as "Splunk Server", title as "Mount Point", FreeGB as "Free (GB)", CapacityGB as "Capacity (GB)", PctFree as "% Free", MinFreeGB as "minFreeSpace Threshold (GB)"
| rest /services/kvstore/status splunk_server=* | table splunk_server, status | rename splunk_server as "Splunk Server", status as Status
| rest /services/cluster/config splunk_server=* | table splunk_server, mode, site, multisite | rename splunk_server as "Splunk Server", mode as Mode, site as Site, multisite as Multisite
| rest /services/licenser/pools splunk_server=local | eval PctUsed=if(quota>0,round((used_bytes/quota)*100,1),0) | stats max(PctUsed) as PctUsed | table PctUsed
